verses.text: For the music director. To be played with flutes. A psalm of David. LORD, listen to my words. Think about what I am saying.
Hear my cry for help, my King and my God, because I pray to you.
LORD, in the morning you hear my voice. In the morning I bring my requests to you and wait for your answer.
You are not a God who is pleased with evil. Evil people cannot live with you.
Proud people cannot stand in front of you. You hate everyone who does evil.
You destroy those who tell lies. The LORD hates people who murder and cheat.
But because of your great and faithful love, I will come into your house. I will bow down toward your holy temple with deep respect.
LORD, lead me in your goodness, because I have enemies. Make your path straight in front of me.
Nothing they say can be trusted. Their hearts are full of destruction. Their throats are like an open grave. They use their tongues to flatter.
God, declare them guilty. Let their own plans make them fall. Throw them out because of their many sins, because they have rebelled against you.
But let everyone who goes to you for safety be glad. Let them always shout for joy, because you protect them. Let those who love your name celebrate because of you.
LORD, you bless good people. You surround them with your kindness like a shield.
